description: A from-scratch coconut curry built on an onion-tomato-ginger-garlic masala, made in the Instant Pot and finished with full-fat coconut milk and lime. Served over basmati rice and topped with crispy air-fried cod instead of chicken. Dairy-free and gluten-free.
name: Coconut Curry with Air-Fried Cod
recipeIngredient: 1 cup tomato puree (canned, or 2 blended tomatoes)
1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder (or paprika)
1.25 pounds cod fillets, cut into 4 portions
recipeInstructions: Set Instant Pot to Sauté and heat. Add ghee, then cumin seeds; sizzle 30 seconds.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic. Sauté about 3 minutes until onions are golden.
Add tomato puree and all ground spices. Sauté 2-3 minutes.
Add water and stir, scraping the bottom. Cancel Sauté, seal the lid, and set the vent to sealing.
Pressure cook on high for 4 minutes, then quick-release.
Stir in coconut milk and garam masala; simmer on Sauté 4-5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir in lime juice and season to taste. Keep warm on the Keep Warm setting.
While the sauce simmers, pat the cod dry and rub with olive oil, garam masala, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Air-fry the cod for 8-10 minutes, until it flakes easily and reaches 145°F internal temperature. No need to flip.
Spoon rice into bowls, ladle coconut curry sauce over the rice, and top each with a piece of air-fried cod. Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges.
